Definition: to grow fat (i.e. be covered with flesh)
BiblicalUsage: Jeshurun grew fat and kicked, full and comfortable and then turning away from the God who made him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe plenty is a test of its own, because a full belly can forget the hand that filled it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
